title: Capstone: an End-to-End Tabular Model
learning_objectives: Combine a stratified split, a ColumnTransformer and a classifier in one pipeline
Tune the model with cross-validated grid search on the training set only
Report a baseline, the cross-validated score and the final test scores
hints: Check `target in df.columns` and that its values are exactly {0, 1}; split before anything is fitted.
Build the ColumnTransformer as in the previous step and wrap it with the model in a Pipeline.

failure_feedback.advice: Tune with GridSearchCV on the training split, then score the best estimator on the test split.
Split with test_size=0.25, stratify=y, random_state=seed before fitting anything.
Impute and use OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') inside the pipeline.
Raise ValueError if the target column is missing or not 0/1.
